svg.title: Particle motion in solids, liquids and gases
svg.desc: Solid atoms vibrate about fixed sites linked by bonds, liquid particles stay in contact while changing neighbors, and gas particles fly freely and bounce off the walls. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Particles in a solid, a liquid, and a gas
Schematic motion, not to scale. Bonds (gray lines) keep solid atoms near their sites; liquid
particles stay close but slip past one another.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
